*   `!r B9`: Red Sub-Concept pawn on B9 (Building / Monument / City). This means "a building" or "a city" is a key part/feature/related idea.
    *   `+ A8`: Red cube on A8 (Idea / Intelligence / Concept). This modifies B9. So, a "building for ideas/intelligence".
    *   `+ B14`: Red cube on B14 (House – Dwelling / Room / Domestic). This also modifies B9. So, a "dwelling/home for ideas" or "a place of intelligence that is like a house".

    *   `B9` (Building) + `A8` (Idea/Intelligence) + `B14` (House/Home).
    *   "A building for ideas/intelligence" + "A home for ideas/intelligence".

    *   *Step 1 Guesses (No):* Think tank, Dream house, Silicon Valley.
    *   *Step 2 Guesses (No):* Smart home, Library, Headquarters.
